en.content: A system does 200 J of work and at the same time absorbs 150 J of heat. The magnitude of the change in internal energy is ____________ J. (Nearest integer)
en.explanation:
w = 200 J, q = +150 : U = q + w

U = 150 200 = 50 J

Magnitude = 50 J = |U |
